_: THE LAGUERRE FILTER AND THE LAGUERRE RSI THAT WERE GRADED. Each entry is a call and the hash (`astHash`) of the formula tree it expands to, which was run through this engine and compared with TradingView running a probe written from the published equations (SPY daily from its listing, 8,509 bars; run studio-laguerre-2026-11-18; the capture is vendor data and is not in the repository). The filter is equal on every bar it has a value for to 1 part in a quadrillion (8,317 bars, a 192-bar restart); the RSI to 2 parts in 100 billion (8,445 bars, a 64-bar restart, which is what that restart leaves). That witnesses this engine's restart against a carried run of the same equations; TradingView has no Laguerre of its own. Both builders (the window's and the server's) must produce exactly these trees. A change that moves a hash is a new formula and needs a new grade before this file may change.
